changelog: Say "remember [word] as [letters]" — or "[word] এর বানান [letters] মনে রাখো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the spelling is saved into My Words, so the next time that name is misheard it is fixed automatically in every future message, without ever opening the app. The current word is fixed in place too, exactly like "spell". The app's My Words list stays in charge: a word already there is never silently overridden.
